result.title: Only What You've Signed up For: Secure Workflows with Constrained Diffusion Agents
result.summary: As agentic AI systems take on increasingly complex and consequential tasks, securing them against prompt injection becomes critical. Existing defenses often rely on detecting or reasoning about injected malicious instructions and can therefore remain vulnerable to adaptive attacks that optimize the injection itself. Diffusion language models (dLLMs), an emerging framework for language generation, offer a new opportunity for security enforcement: by iteratively refining their sequence wide predictions, they enable broader-scope constraint enforcement throughout generation. This paper introduces Policy-Constrained Diffusion Agents (CoDA), a framework that enforces task dependent security policies directly within the denoising process of diffusion language models. At each denoising step, CoDA projects token distributions onto a policy-compliant set, maintaining constraint satisfaction throughout generation. We evaluate CoDA across state-of-the-art diffusion language model families under both static and adaptive prompt-injection attacks. Results demonstrate substantial reductions in attack success rate with competitive task utility and practical inference overhead.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CoDA，在扩散语言模型的去噪过程中逐步把 token 分布投影到任务相关的策略合规集合上，以持续满足安全约束并抵御 prompt injection，并在静态与自适应攻击下评估攻击成功率、任务效用与推理开销。
